**A behaviour change to note.** The spec deny list (`SpecDeniedV4`) includes the private and shared-address ranges (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 100.64/10). Before this PR, a RELATED ICMP error from such a source, for example a fragmentation-needed or time-exceeded message from an on-path router with a private address, reached the member through the generic established/related accept. The fail-closed source guard now drops it, even when the quoted connection is allowed. The existing PMTU evidence (F8-02) uses the allowed origin as the source and does not cover this case. The lane invented no exception; the question goes to the owner (routed item 4).
